tasks.gr9-hydraulics-pneumatics-t2: Topic: Hydraulics, pneumatics and Pascal's principle. Cover fluid pressure, syringes as demonstrators, pneumatic and hydraulic systems, force multiplication, and Pascal's principle. Ask Grade 9 learners to compare hydraulic and pneumatic systems, explain pressure transfer and force multiplication using Pascal's principle, solve mechanical advantage calculations, and analyze system diagrams to predict outcomes.
tasks.gr9-gears-pulleys-t2: Topic: Gears and pulleys. Cover fixed and movable pulleys, block and tackle arrangements, spur gears, bevel gears, worm gears, and rack-and-pinion systems. Ask Grade 9 learners to draw gear-train diagrams, identify pulley types and their functions, predict direction and speed changes in gear systems, calculate speed ratios, and choose appropriate mechanisms for practical applications.
tasks.gr9-mechanical-control-systems-t2: Topic: Mechanical control systems. Cover the ratchet and pawl (one-way turning, degrees per click from the number of teeth), the disc brake (pads, friction, hydraulic pressure with Pascal's principle), the bicycle brake (lever and cable, mechanical advantage) and the cleat (holding and releasing a rope). Ask Grade 9 learners to explain how each works, calculate degrees per click, brake pad force from piston areas, and lever mechanical advantage.
